body.name: VH
body.type: For each \(H\in\mathcal H\), a finite set of rational vectors.
body.def: \(\mathcal V_H\) is the canonical list obtained by solving \(A_{H,S}x_S=b_H\) over every linearly independent support \(S\subseteq H\), extending each nonnegative solution by zeros, and removing duplicates; \(\text{lem:rational-factor-vertices}\) derives \(\mathcal V_H=\operatorname{ext}(K_H)\).
